==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Dionysia:''' {{Rover}}, care for a one-of-a-kind glass of [[Troupe Strength]]?
:{{DIcon}} One-of-a-kind?
:'''Dionysia:''' Yes! Feast your eyes, this bottle is a special edition personally signed by the [[Brant|captain]]. It's rich and sweet, bold on the tongue, with a finish that's as invigorating as the captain's own presence on stage.
:'''Dionysia:''' And here's another! This one's signed by our soprano, [[Tina]]. Care to give it a try?
:{{DIcon}} Is there one signed by [[Roccia]]?
::'''Dionysia:''' The first mate is still a child! She doesn't drink this stuff.
:{{DIcon}} Ah, you're a collector, then?
::'''Dionysia:''' These are my treasures.
:'''Dionysia:''' At every performance, the troupe's actors bring out their own brews and sell them to the audience.
:'''Dionysia:''' When the performance ends, the audience rushes to catch their favorite actors for an autograph. It's all part of the charm!
:'''Dionysia:''' How about a bottle?
{{Dialogue End}}
